name: Arpachshad
overview: Arpachshad is a male biblical figure identified primarily as the son of Shem, one of Noah's sons, according to Genesis 10:22. The Scripture does not provide additional tribal affiliation or notable personal attributes beyond his genealogical placement. His role is primarily genealogical within the biblical narrative.
namesAndTitles: The individual is known by two proper names: Arpachshad, as recorded in Genesis 10:22, and Arphaxad, as found in Luke 3:36. Neither name is given by God nor is there an explicit meaning provided in the biblical text for these names.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Arpachshad is the son of Shem and the father of Shelah, as noted in Genesis 10:22 and Genesis 10:24 respectively. No further family relationships are detailed beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Arpachshad holds significance as a direct descendant of Shem, placing him within the line that leads to the Messiah according to biblical genealogy. His mention in both Genesis and Luke links the Old Testament patriarchal lineage with the New Testament genealogy of Christ, underscoring the continuity of God's redemptive plan through the generations.
